abstract: Neoplasms of the fallopian tube are extremely uncommon. In addition, the incidence of a mature teratoma of the fallopian tube with incomplete uterine mediastinum is extremely low. In the current case report, we present a case of mature cystic teratoma of the fallopian tube with incomplete uterine mediastinum in a 23-year-old female. This mass was noted on computed tomography (CT) scan and sonographic examination. The patient underwent left salpingectomy and uterine septum incision during surgery. One year later, the individual became pregnant.
abstract_ja: 卵管の腫瘍はきわめてまれである。さらに、不完全子宮縦隔を伴う卵管の成熟奇形腫の発生頻度はきわめて低い。本症例報告では、23歳女性に生じた不完全子宮縦隔を伴う卵管の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の症例を報告する。この腫瘤はCT検査および超音波検査で認められた。患者は左卵管摘出術と子宮中隔切開術を受けた。1年後、患者は妊娠した。
